concerns.text: FR-002 requires administering SART and Ospan 'via a web interface' using OSF repository (v2.1+) scoring algorithms. No task builds or exercises any web-based administration; T002 only implements local scoring functions. Either add a task covering the administration interface or add an explicit task documenting the simulated-data scope narrowing so FR-002 is not silently uncovered.

FR-009 requires a pre-study pilot check (n=5) validating response times in 100–5000 ms AND that 'scoring logic matches the reference implementation before participant recruitment begins'. No task performs the n=5 pilot or a comparison against the OSF reference implementation; T002/T003 only do RT range checks and unit tests of self-written scorers. Add a pilot/reference-comparison task or explicitly defer with justification.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 0 ('Download & verify OSF instrument code (FR-009)') vs tasks.md
concerns.text: The plan's Phase 0 includes downloading and checksum-validating OSF instrument code, and the Constitution Check cites 'Instrument code for SART/Ospan downloaded from OSF (v2.1+) and checksum-validated'. No task in tasks.md performs this download/verification step — the plan element is uncovered.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 2 ('randomize baseline vs. post task order per participant (confound control)') vs tasks.md:T005
concerns.text: Plan Phase 2 mandates randomizing baseline vs. post task order per participant as a confound control. T005 only 'records task administration timestamps'; no task implements the randomization. Either add it to T005/T003 (simulation) or remove it from the plan.

T006 applies Holm-Bonferroni 'across the outcome family' of 5 metrics, while FR-008 and SC-005 specify 'four outcome variables'/'four comparisons'. The tasks doc should state which family size governs so the correction is unambiguous (this is a spec/plan inconsistency surfacing as an uncovered/ambiguous requirement mapping).
